title: BN254 GT logarithm by a full rectangular search

claims.statement: For every full-production BN254 GT target z=g^x, the deterministic rectangular-grid algorithm returns the unique scalar x in [0,r) with success 1, including identity, on the finite scalar-network machine explicitly specified in machine.md. Under the canonical scored-input interpretation of proof.md (811-byte compact JSON representing every mathematical z), total charged W=R/20000 is at most 2^148, peak total storage at most 2^152 bytes, and all preprocessing/advice construction is included without amortization. The first score is the conservative log2 work upper bound 148. Arbitrary whitespace serializations are processed with fully charged R(L), not a uniform constant bound; the fixed score depends on the explicitly disclosed canonical-input interpretation and is not established under an unlimited-raw-serialization interpretation. No heuristic collision assumption, practical execution, novelty or improvement over the published baseline is claimed.
